verdict.rationale: Clerk emits webhook event notifications, such as user created or updated and billing events. Its CLI can relay webhook deliveries to a local handler and verify signatures, so developers can trigger their own actions on events. However, the evidence shows no built-in rules engine: event-to-action logic must be written and hosted in your own backend code. missing for 10: native rule definition or configurable triggers inside Clerk, built-in automatic actions without custom handler code, documentation of event filtering or conditions, independent hands-on corroboration.
